name: How is debris and disposal handled after kitchen cabinets are removed?

mainEntity.name: How is debris and disposal handled after kitchen cabinets are removed?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cabinet removal requires hauling away bulky wood boxes, heavy trim, and potentially old countertops, sinks, and appliances. Disposal options generally include on-site roll-off dumpsters, specialized hauling trailers, or transport to local recycling and donation facilities if the units remain intact. Before work begins, confirm whether your contractor's quote includes full debris haul-away and site sweep-up, or if you will need to arrange municipal bulk pickup or container rental separately.
acceptedAnswer.description: Debris is typically hauled away in trailers, placed in roll-off dumpsters, or taken to donation centers if undamaged; confirm disposal terms in your quote.
